name: American Psychiatric Association Annual Meeting 2027
description: The 180th annual meeting of the American Psychiatric Association, held in New York City with more than 400 scientific sessions and over 1,000 posters. The presidential theme is Our Future: End Stigma, Advance Science, Secure Parity.

deadlines.label: General session submission
deadlines.note: Closes 5:00 p.m. ET. The site will not reopen. All presenter disclosures must be complete by this time.

deadlines.label: Course submission
deadlines.note: Closes 5:00 p.m. ET, same site as general sessions.

deadlines.label: Poster abstract submission
deadlines.note: Closes 5:00 p.m. ET. Resident and medical student poster competition entries use this poster track; no separate resident deadline is published.

deadlines.label: Mental Health Innovation Zone panel submission
deadlines.note: Listed on the same submission site, which closes September 10, 2026 for all submissions.

deadlines.label: Notification for September submissions
deadlines.note: FAQ states results for September submissions are typically released in November 2026; no exact date published.

deadlines.label: New Research poster submission opens
deadlines.note: Late poster track for research not previously presented or published.

deadlines.label: New Research poster submission deadline
deadlines.note: Closes 5:00 p.m. ET. Results typically released in late February 2027.

deadlines.label: Registration cancellation deadline (full refund)
deadlines.note: Registration page states advance registration for 2027 is open, although parts of that page still describe the 2026 San Francisco program.

deadlines.label: General session, course and poster submission

sources.note: Confirms 2027 meeting in New York and submission site closing September 10, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. ET.
Confirms May 1 to 5, 2027, New York City, presidential theme, and submission formats (general session, poster, course, MHIZ).
Confirms New Research poster window (opens November 12, 2026, closes January 8, 2027 at 5:00 p.m. ET) and notification timing.
Meetings listing shows 2027 Annual Meeting May 1 to 5, 2027 in New York City; 2028 Chicago May 6 to 10; 2029 San Francisco May 5 to 9.
Confirms the 2026 meeting was at the Moscone Convention Center, San Francisco.

notes: Venue not yet published on psychiatry.org; prior New York meetings used the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center, so coordinates point to Midtown Manhattan. The 2026 general submission deadline (September 11, 2025) comes from a search engine snippet of the psychiatry.org FAQ. 2026 registration opened November 12, 2025, the same calendar day the 2027 New Research poster site opens, so 2027 registration may follow a similar pattern; not confirmed.
